name: multiplexer-reversal
netlist:
simulator lang=spectre
global 0
ahdl_include "dut.va"
Vvin (vin 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0.84 4.2e-07 0.84 4.20001e-07 -0.81 1.72e-06 -0.81]
DUT (vin out) identified_driver
simulatorOptions options reltol=1e-7 vabstol=1e-10 iabstol=1e-13
tran tran stop=1.72e-06 maxstep=2e-9 errpreset=conservative
save out vin
